purpose: 官网文章配图：首次配置、推送生态、网盘支持、数据持久化、Docker 架构

assets.prompt:
Use case: compositing, with a precise infographic-diagram composition.
Edit target / input image 1: the existing CloudSaver project logo. Expand this logo asset into a finished documentation infographic. Preserve the supplied cyan-and-azure interlocking CS cloud-ribbon symbol faithfully as an incorporated small brand badge. Do not redesign it or replace it with a generic cloud. Its white circular field may blend into a white card. Recompose the rest of the canvas completely around the existing brand asset according to the specification below. The final image must be an opaque landscape documentation illustration, not a standalone logo.
Style: cohesive professional product documentation information design, matching the site's earlier clean blue-purple workflow illustrations. White background, pale indigo panels (#F5F6FF), restrained indigo (#5B62D8) connectors and thin borders, dark slate text (#243047). The supplied logo keeps its own cyan-blue colors. Flat precise line icons, clean rounded cards, subtle depth only from very soft shadows. No photorealism, no chunky 3D, no cartoons, no people, no photographic texture, no dotted background, no large decoration.
Typography: correctly rendered Simplified Chinese in a modern clean sans serif; dark high-contrast labels with a clear hierarchy. All exact text below must be rendered verbatim with no missing characters. Diagram will be displayed in a 700 CSS px documentation column: labels must remain legible at that size. Large, high-resolution landscape artwork about 2000 x 1400 px, modest outer margins. Use deliberate whitespace and alignment. No watermark, no fake product UI, no invented third-party logos or unsupported product claims. Only draw semantic generic icons for external services. No text other than specified labels and optional small "CloudSaver" branding beside the preserved logo.
Primary request: A five-step first-use roadmap for new CloudSaver users. Use one vertical ordered stack of five wide compact rows with downward progression, numbered 01 to 05. Each row has a small line icon, a bold step name and one short explanation. The third row contains two equally weighted pills indicating alternatives; do not make them look like consecutive steps. Small brand badge in the header next to the title. Balanced editorial diagram, do not resemble a screenshot.
Exact text:
Title: "首次使用路线图"
01 heading: "注册管理员账号"; explanation: "使用管理员邀请码"
02 heading: "按需配置代理"; explanation: "TG 频道路线需要"; small pill: "可选"
03 heading: "添加搜索源"; two parallel option pills: "TG 公开频道" and "外部搜索源"; explanation: "二选一，也可同时使用"
04 heading: "配置网盘 Cookie"; explanation: "转存时需要"
05 heading: "搜索与转存"; explanation: "选资源 → 选目录 → 可选推送"
Important semantic invariant: proxy configuration is optional and applies to the TG route; the external search backend route does not require Telegram network access. Do not print credentials, invitation codes, URLs or fake input fields.

Primary request: Explain the relationship between a replaceable CloudSaver Docker container and persistent directories on its host machine. Two main stacked zones with clean paired vertical mount connectors.
Title: "容器与持久化目录"
UPPER zone: a wide rounded Docker container outline. Header uses the preserved small CS logo beside "CloudSaver 容器". A compact subtitle "更新镜像 / 重建容器". Inside the lower edge of this zone, two separate path blocks: "/app/data" and "/app/config".
LOWER zone: a separate pale outlined area headed "宿主机". Inside it, two folder cards aligned directly under their matching container paths:
Left folder heading "data", explanation "数据库与运行数据".
Right folder heading "config", explanation "环境配置与版本文案".
Connect "/app/data" straight down to "data", and "/app/config" straight down to "config"; each connector label "卷挂载". Paths must use the literal slash characters correctly; no other paths, code or shell commands.
Footer note: "升级时保持原有挂载目录"
Important invariant: persistent data lives in the separately mounted host folders, not inside the replaceable application layer. Do not imply that unmounted data survives removal or that unrelated folders can be substituted.

Primary request: An accurate developer-oriented architecture diagram of the DOCKER production deployment. One browser node outside and above a large rounded rectangular container boundary. Within the boundary: frontend left, Nginx middle, Express backend right; storage under the backend. Draw precise short arrows and readable route labels.
Title: "Docker 运行架构"
Top outside node heading: "浏览器"; secondary: "PC / 移动端"; generic monitor and phone icons.
Large container boundary label: "Docker 单容器"; small preserved CloudSaver logo at the boundary header.
Top browser arrow goes DOWN into the middle Nginx node, edge label: "HTTP :8008".
Middle node heading: "Nginx"; secondary: ":8008".
Left node heading: "Vue 3 前端"; secondary: "静态资源".
Arrow from Nginx LEFT toward Vue card, labelled "/" (serving frontend static resources).
Right node heading: "Express 后端"; secondary: ":8009".
Arrow from Nginx RIGHT toward Express card, labelled "/api/".
Storage card below the Express card, heading: "SQLite"; secondary: "数据存储".
Arrow DOWN from Express to SQLite, edge label: "Sequelize".
Important invariant: Nginx is the single external entry point at port 8008; Express at port 8009 is inside the same Docker container. Do not draw a public arrow directly to port 8009. Do not connect Vue directly to SQLite. Keep node edges, arrow labels and container boundaries clearly separated, with no crossing paths. Do not add extra services or cloud deployment logos.
